title: The Orbital Chaos Cube Cannon
description:
Could the sulfur cube become the ultimate nuke? In this video we design a sulfur cube cannon with the potential to rival the orbital strike cannon. However you might find that while the sulfur cube offers some interesting perks, it also comes with some significant tradeoffs. Join cubicmetre as he investigates the capabilities of the sulfur cube in the context of TnT cannon technology.
